name: Can accessible flooring help prevent falls for elderly residents?

mainEntity.name: Can accessible flooring help prevent falls for elderly residents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, accessible flooring plays a crucial role in preventing falls for elderly residents. By providing a stable, level, and slip-resistant surface, it minimizes common trip hazards found in many homes. Features like low-pile or no-pile carpets reduce snagging, while non-slip finishes on hard surfaces like vinyl or laminate offer better traction. Eliminating uneven transitions between rooms or different flooring types also significantly lowers the risk of tripping. This creates a safer environment, allowing seniors to move more confidently and independently within their homes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, accessible flooring prevents falls for elderly residents by offering stable, level, slip-resistant surfaces and eliminating trip hazards like uneven transitions.
